goal: Iske baad aap structure ko function mein by value, by reference, by const reference aur by pointer pass kar sakte hain, arrow operator use kar sakte hain, aur har kaam ke liye sahi tareeqa chun sakte hain.
warmup: Ek student office mein form deta hai. Option 1: clerk photocopy banata hai aur copy par remarks likhta hai; original saaf rehta hai. Option 2: clerk ko original form milta hai aur woh us par likhta hai. Option 3: clerk original parh sakta hai lekin kuch likhne ki ijazat nahi. Option 4: clerk ko sirf bataya jata hai ke form kis shelf par rakha hai. Function mein jane wale structure ke paas bilkul yehi chaar options hain.
definition: Structure variable ko kisi bhi doosre variable ki tarah function ko bheja ja sakta hai. By value (void f(Student s)): function ko har member ki poori copy milti hai, is liye return hone par tabdeeliyan zaya ho jati hain. By reference (void f(Student &s)): s caller ke variable ka doosra naam hai, is liye tabdeeliyan rehti hain. By const reference (void f(const Student &s)): reference ki tarah, lekin function wada karta hai ke woh usay nahi badlega, aur koi copy nahi banti. By pointer (void f(Student *p)): function ko variable ka address milta hai. Pointer ke zariye hum members tak arrow operator se pohanchte hain: p->marks, jis ka matlab (*p).marks ke barabar hai.
howItWorks: Pehla trace step by step dekhein aur call stack par nazar rakhein. bonusByValue mein function ko NAYA box s milta hai jis mein a ki copy bhari hoti hai. Woh copy mein 5 add karta hai, aur function khatam hone par copy phenk di jati hai, is liye main mein ab bhi 60 hi hai. bonusByRef mein koi naya box nahi banta. s wohi box hai jo a hai, is liye 5 marks a mein add ho jate hain. Function show const reference use karta hai: woh structure ki copy nahi banata, aur agar hum usay badalne ki koshish karein to compiler humein rok deta hai. Hamesha by value kyun nahi? Structure mein bohat se members ho sakte hain, is liye har dafa copy karna slow aur fuzool hai. Teesra trace pointer wala tareeqa dikhata hai: function ko address milta hai, is liye sirf ek chhota sa address copy hota hai, aur arrow -> usay follow kar ke asli structure tak pohanchta hai. Aasaan rule: sirf parhna ho to const Type &. Badalna ho to Type &. Chhota struct ho aur aap apni alag copy chahte hon to by value theek hai. Pointer: tab use karein jab notes ya exam us ka taqaza karein, ya jab address maujood na hone ka imkan ho.
